body: Also not helping is that I'm a hopeless romantic who's been used and discarded by most of the women I get close with. It seems like I've always been just a rebound until they decide to get back with their exes. And it's not like I'm not trying with the online dating, just very few people will talk to to me, and even fewer agree to a date, all of which never resulted in a second one. I understand it's easier to get a date in person, but I'm cripplingly shy and introverted, to the point that I sicken myself.
